title: One-step finite point transport preserves the regular coefficient unit
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l and a finite quotient index m≥0 [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write s=Spec D.k and g_s for geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Let B_{s,m} be the regular finite coefficient object and d_{g_s} its canonical pullback multiplication [lem-zl-coefficient-pullback-unit-coordinates]. The actual one-step point transport iota on B_{s,m} [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], followed by the finite point-sections image [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] of d_{g_s}, is the identity on the derived sections of B_{s,m}.

source.place: Constant-sheaf clause; reviewed expansion of lem-zl-constant-geometric-stalk-unit, step 4

proof.text: At the final object of the pro-etale site of Spec k, the constant-section map from the coefficient ring to its sheafification is bijective. Thus it suffices to compute on a constant section a.

source.place: Constant-sheaf clause; reviewed expansion of lem-zl-constant-geometric-stalk-unit, step 4

proof.text: Restriction along g_s sends a to the same constant a. The inverse-image colimit coprojection and sheafification give its constant class. The inverse-image-to-pullback comparison inserts the tensor unit. Regular multiplication sends that tensor back to a, by its adjunction generator formula. This proves the identity on actual sections.

source.place: Constant-sheaf clause; reviewed expansion of lem-zl-constant-geometric-stalk-unit, step 4

proof.text: The exact degree-zero single-complex comparisons identify the derived composite with this sectionwise calculation. Naturality and the localization formula for point transport conjugate the calculation across the representative selected in its definition. Hence the actual derived transport followed by multiplication is the identity, also for the exponent-one quotient.

theorem finitePointTransport_unit
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) (m : ℕ) :
    frobeniusPointTransportFinite D l hl E m
        (finiteConstantCoefficientObject l E (Spec (.of D.k)) m) ≫
      (pointFiniteSections D.k
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (finiteUnit l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom m).hom = 𝟙 _
